title: Determination of carcinogenic polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in water by extraction and chromatography
author: Ballesteros-Gómez, Ana
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Filter water sample
steps.instruction: Filter 36 mL of the water sample to remove particulates (method tolerates salt concentrations up to 1 M and pH below 4).

steps.title: Prepare THF/decanoic acid solvent
steps.instruction: In a clean vial, dissolve 70 mg decanoic acid in 4 mL tetrahydrofuran (THF).

steps.title: Extract CPAHs with coacervate
steps.instruction: Add the 4 mL THF/decanoic acid solution to the filtered 36 mL sample and stir the mixture for 5 min (extraction remains effective up to 60 °C).

steps.title: Centrifuge to separate coacervate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 10 min to allow phase separation; the coacervate phase containing the CPAHs will form.

steps.title: Inject coacervate for LC‑FL
steps.instruction: Withdraw 20 µL of the coacervate phase and inject it into the liquid‑chromatography–fluorimetry (LC‑FL) system for quantification of the seven priority CPAHs.
